description: This file contains utility methods for managing party-related information within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions for retrieving party details, creating IDs, searching for parties based on address and personal info, and navigating party relationships.

classes.name: PartyWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manipulate and query party-related data within the OFBiz system.

methods.name: getPartyOtherValues
methods.description: Retrieves party, person, and party group entities based on partyId and returns them in a map with specified attribute keys.

methods.name: createClubId
methods.description: Generates a unique club ID with a prefix, total length, and a check digit based on a sequence.

methods.name: findPartyLatestContactMech
methods.description: Finds the most recent contact mechanism for a party given a contact mech type.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the latest postal address for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddressGeoPoint
methods.description: Retrieves the geo point of the latest postal address.

methods.name: findPartyLatestTelecomNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the latest telecom number for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestUserLogin
methods.description: Finds the most recent user login record for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the latest login for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the last locale used by the party based on recent login.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyId
methods.description: Finds the first party ID matching specified address and name criteria.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyAndContactMechId
methods.description: Finds the first party and contact mechanism ID matching specified address and personal name criteria.

methods.name: findMatchingPersonPostalAddresses
methods.description: Finds all postal addresses matching provided address and name criteria for persons.

methods.name: findMatchingPartyPostalAddress
methods.description: Finds all party postal address records matching address constraints.

methods.name: makeMatchingString
methods.description: Transforms address strings into a normalized form for matching purposes.

methods.name: getAssociatedPartyIdsByRelationshipType
methods.description: Retrieves all party IDs related to a given party through specified relationship type.

methods.name: findPartiesById
methods.description: Finds parties by ID, optionally looking both in party and party identification tables.

methods.name: findParty
methods.description: Retrieves a party entity by ID.

methods.name: findParties
methods.description: Retrieves a list of parties based on ID and optional identification type.

methods.name: findPartyId
methods.description: Returns the party ID for a given identifier and type.
